description: This file defines the RustAdapter class implementing the Rust::IPlugin interface, including configuration, lifecycle management, and communication methods for a plugin system within the WPEFramework. It also declares related structures and static utility functions.

classes.name: RustAdapter
classes.description: A plugin class implementing the Rust::IPlugin interface, managing plugin lifecycle, configuration, and communication within the WPEFramework.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Nested class within RustAdapter for managing JSON configuration parameters.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell interface.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes a communication channel (conditional on version).

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a token, method, and parameters (conditional on version).

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Handles remote procedure calls, with different signatures based on compilation flags.

methods.name: GetLibraryPathOrName
methods.description: Static utility to get library path or name.

methods.name: GetAuthToken
methods.description: Static utility to get authentication token.
